title: Geologic map of the Wiggins quadrangle, Beaufort and colleton Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2003, Geologic map of the Wiggins quadrangle, Beaufort and colleton Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-18, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Coastal map, OCR; several unit symbols garbled or missing (recorded inferred with OCR text, or left out). Thicknesses printed with '|' recorded as 1, inferred. Terrace-margin elevations in unit descriptions. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 100, feet and meters scales to sea level) read from image tiles: 4 drill holes. 15-56, 15-59 and 7-321 are dashed (projected), so no land-surface elevations; 7-321 runs to the section base with no base bar, so no base recorded. 15-50 is solid: top and base read off the FEET scale (+/-2 ft, inferred). No horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points. No drill holes named in the text. No reference list.
